description:
Full-text search across page transcriptions

Performs a full-text search across the page transcriptions of historical documents indexed by Open Archives. Mirrors the search UI at `/transcripties/zoek.php`. Results are ordered by Elasticsearch relevance (the order is fixed and cannot be overridden) and are returned paginated. Each match includes a source citation, page identifier and up to five highlighted text fragments. The set of facets returned depends on the supplied filters.
name: search_transcriptions

query.description: Echo of the parameters supplied by the caller.

items.description: One match in a transcription search response.

archive_number.description: Archive number (archieftoegang) information for a transcription.

nr.description: Archive number as used by the source institution.

url.description: External URL describing the archive on the source institution's website.

inventory_number.description: Inventory number information for a transcription.

page.description: Page number with leading zeros stripped.

snippets.description: Up to five highlighted text fragments showing where the search terms appear. Each fragment wraps the matching terms in `…` tags.

source_archive.description: Source archive holding the transcribed page.

archive_code.description: openarch archive code (matches the codes used elsewhere in this API).

name.description: Localised name of the source archive.

uri.description: Open Archives URL where the transcription can be viewed.

facets.description: The set of facets returned depends on the supplied filters. With no `archive_code`: `source_archive`. With `archive_code` only: `archive_number`. With both `archive_code` and `archive_number`: `inventory_number`.

number_found.description: Total number of matches across all pages.

title: Search Transcriptions
